payload.summary: Human decision transcribed by agent: keep exact resolver identity separate and render multiple additive provenance badges, but only when proved by structured store facts. direct-human means resolution actor human; delegated means agent resolution citing a human event; ratified means a later human note names the ticket; agent applies otherwise; incomplete is additive for failed joins. Never render cross-agent-grilled without a typed proof marker.
payload.research: fvb6ceqv established the actor/source predicates and the absence of typed cross-agent-grill proof
